name: micro1
work: Expert AI trainer roles: turning professional knowledge in fields like finance, healthcare, engineering and history into AI training data and evaluations.

source.title: Corporate Staffing Kenya: micro1 AI trainer listings in Kenya

availability.note: micro1 publishes no country list we could find. Its AI trainer roles are advertised on a Kenyan job board, so Kenya is marked as reported. Each role sets its own requirements. Other African countries are unclear.

items.text: You apply through micro1's Opportunities Portal. Each role has skill requirements set to match the client's needs.
Every applicant is interviewed by Zara, micro1's AI recruiter. You answer open questions out loud in real time, and the session is recorded for human recruiters to review.
Interviews last 20 to 40 minutes, about 7 minutes for each skill being tested.
Listed roles in Kenya include pattern recognition, finance, history and industrial engineering AI trainers, some part-time at around 10 hours a week.
Answers in the AI interview are recorded and reviewed by human recruiters, so answer in your own words.
